notes.title: Patch Notes 3 - Trading Cards, Movement Improvement & More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Patch 3 for Selfloss is now live, bringing some tweaks and additions to help smooth out your journey through Kazimir’s world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35064091/ad6e49547528ab6dd5c2fb0246668ccded399cc9.png[/img]
[h2]🃏 Steam Trading Cards Are Now Live![/h2]
You can now earn Trading Cards, badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds as you play. Show off your Selfloss style on your Steam profile!

[h2]🚶 Character Movement Improvements[/h2]
Kazimir now moves with improved responsiveness and increased movement speed. These changes aim to give players more precise control and make traversing the world feel smoother and more efficient.

[h2]🚤 Boat Handling Enhancements[/h2]
Sailing is a vital part of the experience, and we’ve made adjustments to improve boat movement and handling. Whether you’re crossing peaceful waters or navigating stormy shores, your boat should now feel more intuitive and responsive.

[h2]🧱 Small Collision Fixes[/h2]
A few minor collision issues have been resolved to keep the world flowing seamlessly as you explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35064091/ad6e49547528ab6dd5c2fb0246668ccded399cc9.png[/img]


As always, thank you for your feedback and support! These updates are part of our continued efforts to make Selfloss the most immersive and meaningful experience it can be.

💙 Stay tuned - more updates to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35064091/0c819084b38525a1ceae80233e5d0607d31b6d02.gif[/img]

[b]– The Selfloss Team
[/b]

[h3][b]Get Selfloss 65% off! The offer ends tomorrow![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Patch Notes 2 - Control improvements + character speed increased
notes.notes:
[b]A new patch is now live for Selfloss![/b]

PATCH NOTES #2

1) [b]Control Improvements: [/b]The staff is now slightly more responsive, and character rotation speed has been increased for a smoother experience.
2) [b]Balance Tweaks:[/b] The protagonist's movement speed has been increased, with animation speeds adjusted accordingly. Attack animations are now faster.
3) [b]Rebalanced Hazards:[/b] Some hazards, such as miasma shrooms, have been slightly rebalanced.
4) [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Rare soft-locking issues in Chapters 1 and 4 have been resolved.
5) [b]Performance Enhancements:[/b] Minor improvements have been made to overall performance.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1 - Ocean Level + Chapter Select Improvements
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

A new patch is now live for Selfloss, which offers key improvements and bug fixes to improve your experience of the Slavic adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35064091/ad6e49547528ab6dd5c2fb0246668ccded399cc9.png[/img]

[h2]PATCH NOTES #1[/h2]

[u][b]Ocean Level Adjustments[/b][/u]
The Ocean level has been made slightly easier with improved rock placement, ensuring smoother navigation.

[u][b]Lich Boss Battle Enhancements[/b][/u]
The Lich boss fight in Chapter 3 has been rebalanced to offer a fairer challenge. Additionally, the miasma pimples are now placed more accessibly, making them easier to reach.

[u][b]Chapter Select Screen Update[/b][/u]
Detailed stats have been added to the Chapter Select screen, allowing you to see how many runic stones or scrolls were missed in each chapter.

[u][b]Critical Bug Fixes[/b][/u]
Several critical game-locking bugs have been fixed, with most issues addressed in previous undocumented patches.

[u][b]Miscellaneous Fixes[/b][/u]
Various minor improvements and bug fixes have been implemented for a smoother gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35064091/ad6e49547528ab6dd5c2fb0246668ccded399cc9.png[/img]

Please continue to leave your feedback of the game in the Discussions Forums or via Reviews - we'd love to hear what you thought about the game!

For any Bug Reporting, please feel free to leave a detailed account of your bug in the Bug Reporting Sub-Forum here: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1086620/discussions/1/


Thank you again for your support for Selfloss! Don't forget, both the full game and the original OST soundtrack are available now on Steam!
